How did Buddhism Spread from India to Southeast Asia | Flashback with Palki Sharma
Buddhism was among the four religions that originated in India. It spread from its birthplace to Central Asia, China and Southeast Asia over many centuries. Though the religion has flourished in other countries, it has largely disappeared from India. Find out why on Flashback with Palki Sharma.
